notes: Run of 2026-11-26. Two Mission Local stories queued. The 1970s–80s photo essay names addresses only as photo captions. The Mission Buzz roundup's headline names two things: the maker space (declined, its address is inconsistent) and the Ling Nam bakery (declined, already on the page from the Chronicle). The roundup's other items (an Italian restaurant on Valencia, a grocery on Mission) are not in its headline, so they are declined under the roundup rule and not written.
